## Publications
```{r}
pubs <- readRDS("publications_full.rds")
```

```{r, results='asis'}

for(yr in sort(unique(pubs$year), decreasing = TRUE)) {

  cat(paste0("\n## ", yr, "\n\n"))

  papers <- pubs[pubs$year == yr, ]

  for(i in seq_len(nrow(papers))) {

    cat(
      paste0(
        papers$authors[i],
        ". ",
        "*", papers$title[i], "*",
        ". _", papers$journal[i], "_",
        ifelse(
          is.na(papers$volume[i]),
          "",
          paste0(", ", papers$volume[i])
        ),
        ". https://doi.org/",
        papers$doi[i],
        "\n\n"
      )
    )
  }
}
```
